# ghost_user (Data Source)

Looks up a Ghost user or organization by `login`, or the authenticated user when `login` is omitted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The user that owns the provider's token.
data "ghost_user" "me" {}

# Any user or organization, by login. Logins are case-sensitive.
data "ghost_user" "octocat" {
  login = "octocat"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `login` (String) The login to look up. Ghost matches logins case-sensitively. Omit it to look up the user that owns the provider's token.

### Read-Only

- `avatar_url` (String) The avatar image URL.
- `created_at` (String) When the account was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `html_url` (String) The profile's web URL.
- `id` (String) The login.
- `name` (String) The display name, null when none is set.
- `node_id` (String) The GraphQL node ID.
- `site_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is a Ghost site administrator.
- `type` (String) Either `User` or `Organization`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the account was last updated, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `user_id` (Number) The numeric user ID.
